original.goal: Record a 2–3 minute video explaining where you fit in a company: the organizational structure, your role, and who you would report to.
original.title: Explaining Where You Fit in a Company
original.body_en:
📹 Video Quiz

Title: Explaining Where You Fit in a Company
Time: 1 hour

Task: Record a 2–3 minute video where you:

Introduce yourself as if it's your first week in a new company.

Explain what kind of organizational structure the company uses (functional, flat, matrix, divisional).

Describe your role and who you would report to.

Tips:

Look directly at the camera, not the screen.

Speak clearly, confidently, and keep background noise low.

End by sharing one question you would ask HR or your manager about your role.

📝 Submission:
Upload your video (MP4 or MOV preferred) to the course platform.

👉 https://classroom.google.com/c/NzgzNjY5MDgwMDkx/a/ODA4OTY1MjA4MzE4/details
original.body_es:
📹 Cuestionario en Video

Título: Explicando Dónde Encajas en una Empresa
Tiempo: 1 hora

Tarea: Graba un video de 2 a 3 minutos donde:

Te presentes como si fuera tu primera semana en una nueva empresa.

Expliques qué tipo de estructura organizacional utiliza la empresa (funcional, plana, matricial, divisional).

Describas tu rol y a quién reportarías.

Consejos:

Mira directamente a la cámara, no a la pantalla.

Habla con claridad, confianza y mantén el ruido de fondo bajo.

Termina compartiendo una pregunta que le harías a Recursos Humanos o a tu gerente sobre tu rol.

📝 Entrega:
Sube tu video (MP4 o MOV preferido) a la plataforma del curso.

👉 https://classroom.google.com/c/NzgzNjY5MDgwMDkx/a/ODA4OTY1MjA4MzE4/details
